criterion: Same basic bibliographic closure as first 20: documented source, reference/studied dose, key precautions and interactions, use and personalization limits
verified_corrections: Manganese: NIH ODS states no known clinically relevant medication interactions; removed unsupported antibiotic separation claim.
Phosphorus: pregnancy UL 3500 mg/day for 19–50; corrected source detail.
Biotin: assay interference with troponin and thyroid tests.
Beta-alanine: paresthesia at >=800 mg single dose or >10 mg/kg.
Caffeine: 400 mg/day general FDA healthy adult context is not universal safe dose.
Protein: 1.2–2.0 g/kg/day is total intake, not supplement dose.
exclusions: No app integration or functionality testing
